```artifact
Feature: Offline Consultation

  Scenario: Payments are free
    Given the user is on the consultation page
    When the user selects a payment method
    Then the payment status is "Free"

  Scenario: Credit/ Debit/ Net Banking enabled thru a Payment Gateway
    Given the user is on the consultation page
    When the user selects a payment method
    Then the payment gateway is displayed

  Scenario: Error messages appear at the bottom
    Given the user is on the consultation page
    When the user enters invalid data
    Then an error message appears at the bottom with the content "Invalid data entered"

  Scenario: Error messages are self descriptive
    Given the user is on the consultation page
    When the user enters invalid data
    Then an error message appears with the content "Invalid data entered"

  Scenario: Error messages have a maximum size of 80 Characters
    Given the user is on the consultation page
    When the user enters an error message with 80 characters
    Then the error message is displayed
    And the error message has a maximum size of 80 Characters

  Scenario: Buttons are used to make navigation simpler
    Given the user is on the consultation page
    When the user clicks on a button
    Then the user is navigated to the next page

  Scenario: Patient Registration and Consultation Requests screens have bigger font size
    Given the user is on the consultation page
    When the user views the page
    Then the font size is bigger

  Scenario: Exception error message is displayed “Symptom does not exist”
    Given the user is on the consultation page
    When the user selects a non-existent symptom
    Then an error message appears with the content "Symptom does not exist"

  Scenario Outline: Payment methods
    Given the user is on the consultation page
    When the user selects a payment method
    Then the payment method is <payment_method>
    Examples:
      | payment_method |
      | Credit         |
      | Debit          |
      | Net Banking    |

  Scenario Outline: Payment gateway presence
    Given the user is on the consultation page
    When the user selects a payment method
    Then the payment gateway is <payment_gateway_presence>
    Examples:
      | payment_gateway_presence |
      | displayed                |
      | not displayed            |

  Scenario Outline: Error message length
    Given the user is on the consultation page
    When the user enters an error message with <error_message_length> characters
    Then the error message is displayed
    Examples:
      | error_message_length |
      | 80                    |
      | 79                    |
      | 81                    |

  Scenario: PC/Laptop compatibility
    Given the user is on the consultation page
    When the user views the page on a PC/Laptop
    Then the page is displayed correctly
```
